title: Even scaling of restricted Fourier coefficients
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $f$ be a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional binary cube, and suppose every Fourier coefficient of $f$ has absolute value $2^{-\lfloor n/2\rfloor}$. Let $J$ be a set of coordinates whose complement is nonempty, let $A\subseteq J$, and fix signs on the coordinates outside $J$. Then the Fourier coefficient indexed by $A$ of the restriction of the corresponding sign-cube function, with those outside signs fixed, is $q\,2^{-\lfloor n/2\rfloor}$ for some even integer $q$.
